# XIVKit

> XIVKit is a curated, unofficial list of Final Fantasy XIV (FFXIV) tools, Dalamud plugins, and player-run venues that the maintainer actually uses, plus original guides hosted on the site. Every entry is hand-picked and annotated with why it's useful, rather than an exhaustive directory.

The site is static and every page is plain HTML. Market board prices on the guides are fetched live from Universalis. FINAL FANTASY XIV is a registered trademark of Square Enix Holdings Co., Ltd. XIVKit is fan-made and not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix.

## Guides

- [Jump Puzzle Macros](https://xivkit.com/jump-puzzle-macros.html): Timed macro-and-hotbar technique for jumping exact, repeatable distances in FFXIV jumping puzzles, with copyable macros and a calibration spot.
- [Hunt for Astronomy: What's Worth the Tomes](https://xivkit.com/hunt-for-astronomy.html): Every reward in the Hunt for Astronomy trove, its alternate sources, market board prices, and a verdict on whether it's worth the tomestones.
- [Trade-In Mounts: Grind vs. Buy the Mats](https://xivkit.com/trade-in-mounts.html): Every FFXIV mount unlocked by trading in items or currency, with live market board prices and a verdict on grinding versus buying.
- [Inventory & Retainer Decluttering](https://xivkit.com/inventory-decluttering.html): A keep, bank, or discard decision tree for a full bag or retainer, with storage tips, ways to sell or desynthesize, and the short list of items that never come back once discarded.

## Lists

- [Tools & Links](https://xivkit.com/): Curated FFXIV tools grouped by use: market and economy, progress trackers, glamour, housing, reference databases, and community sites.
- [Plugins](https://xivkit.com/plugins.html): Dalamud plugins in active use, tagged by whether they're in the default plugin directory or need a custom (experimental) repo.
- [Venues](https://xivkit.com/venues.html): Player-run FFXIV venues with open hours converted to your local time and a Lifestream address.

## Optional

- [Watchlist](https://xivkit.com/watchlist.html): FFXIV tools that are recommended but not yet tried by the maintainer.
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/malobear/xivkit): The site's source, open to pull requests.
